Full job description

We are looking for an existing Remote Financial Accountant - AI Trainer to help train AI models. In this role, you will evaluate AI chatbot responses, assess their reasoning and logic, and solve complex problems to help improve overall model quality.

In this role, you will need expert-level financial reasoning skills. A bachelor's degree is required, and a completed or in-progress master's or PhD is preferred. Relevant fields include, but are not limited to, financial accounting, investment banking, wealth management, and insurance planning.

Advantages of contracting with us:

You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
Projects are paid hourly at $50 to $100 USD per hour, with bonus rates available on some projects

Responsibilities

Provide AI chatbots with diverse, complex finance problems
Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reasoning quality, and performance

Qualifications

Fluency in English (native or bilingual proficiency)
Strong attention to detail
Proficiency in accounting, financial analysis, financial modeling, data analysis, and other finance-related reasoning tasks
A completed, in-progress, or current master's and/or PhD is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask you for any fees or payments.
